import os,re,numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for name in ['Demo pair %d input'%i for i in (1,2,3)] + ['Test input']:
    I=np.array(G[name]); print('---',name,I.shape)
    cnt=Counter(I.flat); bcol=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0]; bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(I.shape[0]) for c in range(I.shape[1]) if I[r,c]==bcol]
    rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    # pattern color(s)
    patcols=sorted(set(cnt)-{bgc,bcol})
    for pc in patcols:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(I.shape[0]) for c in range(I.shape[1]) if I[r,c]==pc]
        inside=[p for p in pts if r0<=p[0]<=r1 and c0<=p[1]<=c1]
        outside=[p for p in pts if not(r0<=p[0]<=r1 and c0<=p[1]<=c1)]
        print(f'  pat {pc}: n={len(pts)}, inside={[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in sorted(inside)]}, outside={outside}')

import os,re,numpy as np,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
